body: The pair is streaked with clouded sample jar from treated rows. It was set aside after the flies vanished, before anyone marked the toolbox unsafe.
title: Clouded sample jar by the toolbox
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

title: The flour stayed behind
body: I was told to leave the kitchen open for one more shift, though the road count already included its address. I set aside a clean apron for the morning cook. The second list, the one for people waiting inside, came back with no names.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
